newFindings.title: Type with many members
newFindings.rationale: Large types often become aggregation points for unrelated behavior.

review.responsibility: Existing Persistence query projects the unique current claim expiry. Existing publication fence rechecks time after the root transaction lock. Read-only child/grant identity is unchanged.
review.dependencies: No project-reference, module, partial-class, service-locator, public interface, database schema or DI-registration change. Existing TimeProvider is injected.
review.performance: Same single selected SQL query. Correlated claim lookup matches existing RunId+ClaimToken primary key plus step/attempt/status. No history or material payload scan.
review.testability: Explicit deterministic clock; real PostgreSQL token/attempt/status/expiry and blocked-root wait cases. Existing manager review and unrelated-root regressions retained.
review.findingReview: One new informational finding: existing internal observation DTO now has9 source members because it retains matching claim expiry alongside historical fields. It owns no orchestration.

final-resource-reconciliation.json.outcome: All106 selected Process claim-lifetime and related publication, reader, scope and funding cases pass. Source/runtime unchanged. Historical cleanup denials remain unchanged.
